title: 第十一章 直道

content_zh:
上了岁数之后，睡眠本来就少。但是自从中风之后，放徐乐出门行商，徐敢自己屋中，夜中油灯，似乎就没有熄灭的时候。
一夜夜的，徐敢就靠在胡床之上，望着北面。虽然北面并没有开窗，但徐敢的目光，似乎能穿透墙壁，远及云中关山，直跟随在自己从长安城中抱出来的孩子身边。
自己已经是风烛残年了，一桩桩一件件的往事在心头滑过，盛年之际的金戈铁马，十几年前开始的乡里生活，都是过眼云烟，唯一放不下的，就是这个被自己一手养大的孙子而已。
儿子儿媳，正在地下等着自己呢。到了那儿，自己会告诉他们，这孩子，被老头子养得很出色……
外间传来了轻轻的脚步响动之声，徐敢耳朵一动，分辨来人。
不是韩小六，徐乐出行没有带他，韩小六这些时日一直郁郁寡欢。嘴上都可以挂油瓶了。他应该是守在外间值夜的，小孩子瞌睡多，现在估计正睡得昏天黑地。
只会是韩氏。
这个自己当年北上之际，在河东救下的一家人。一直忠心耿耿的跟随自己，开荒，落户。丈夫逝去以一个女子操持徐家的内外家务，就连儿子韩约，现下也都在徐乐身边，一起冒险北上。
厚重的门帘掀开，进来的果然是韩氏，她端着一个托盘，托盘上放着热气腾腾的麦粥，还有一碟腌菜，一碟熏鱼肉。满脸担心的看着徐敢。
“太公，今天一天都没吃下什么，觉也不睡，这样下去可怎么得了。是不是稍微吃点才好？”
徐敢勉强一笑：“一天下来，药都喝饱了，哪里还吃得下。一会儿我自然去睡，韩氏你就不用挂心了。”
韩氏放下托盘，看着徐敢：“太公是挂心乐郎君罢……”
徐敢闭上眼睛。
韩氏眼圈有点泛红，用袖子擦了一下：“我也是看着乐郎君长大的，落得一表人才。现下世道这么乱，当年太公不许乐郎君出神武一步，现下怎么为了点免行钱就让乐郎君去吃这个辛苦？实在不成，房子地都卖了，还怕这一关过不去？”
徐敢闭着眼睛轻声开口：“老头子保护不了他太久了……”
韩氏停住语声，听着老人一句句的说下去，语声当中，竟然是说不出的萧索：“天下要乱了……而我，也老了。我曾经想过，就让阿乐平凡的过完这一生也罢。但那是太平世道的事情。现下，却又是一个即将尸山血海，群雄竞逐的岁月要开始了……在这个年月，阿乐的一身本事，是藏不住的，藏不住的啊……”
老人语声喃喃，竟然有一种说不出的神秘感：“这种大乱之世，老天爷自会召唤无数豪杰之士出来，用他们的血肉献祭，直到让最后一人站在至高之处。躲不过的，躲不过的……若是十年前，就是我去拼了这把老骨头，但是现在，我去之后，只有靠阿乐自己了。我只能让他上路，尽早见识这个世道的腥风血雨……”
有些话语，韩氏并没有听懂。却明白了大概意思，颤抖着声音发问：“那乐郎君，会没事吧……”
一直委顿的徐敢突然睁眼，老眼中威光四射，凌厉如电！
“我徐敢一手教出的孙子，如何会有事？阿乐天姿过于其父，锋锐之气更是天生，只要始终秉胸中直道而行，天要压下，他都能将天捅一个窟窿！”

韩氏重复着她不懂的两字：“直道？”
徐敢厉声道：“不要屈身辱志，为世家走狗。纵然杀人盈野，也只为还世间一个太平！”
在这一瞬间，徐敢眼前，似乎又浮现出一个青年。比徐乐稍长一些，不足三十的年纪。眉眼酷肖徐乐，只是比徐乐看起来神情更加稳重一些。身姿挺拔，对着自己大声开口。
“……孩儿不是去贪图将来富贵，而是越国公与晋王谗杀高熲，祸乱朝纲，并谋夺储君之位。大隋终南北分立，五胡乱华之世。不能让这太平之世败坏在越国公与晋王手里！儿子奉国公之命，决意扈卫太子，只为守护胸中直道！”
人影幻灭而去，徐敢紧闭双眼，一滴老泪滑落：“……可孩儿你还是被世家抛弃了啊……老头子这十几年来，无时无刻不在想你，无时无刻，无时无刻……”
韩氏不敢再打扰徐敢，轻轻回转，掀起门帘之后忍不住又回头看了一眼。

content_en:
As I get older, I get less sleep. But since he suffered a stroke and Xu Le was released to go out on business, Xu Gan's oil lamp in his own house seemed to never go out at night.
Night after night, Xu Gan leaned on the bed and looked to the north. Although there were no windows on the north side, Xu Gan's eyes seemed to be able to penetrate the wall and reach as far as Yunzhongguan Mountain, directly following the child he had taken out of Chang'an City.
He is already in his twilight years, and the past events are passing through his mind one after another. The fierce fighting in his prime, and the life in the countryside that began more than ten years ago are all passing by. The only thing he can't let go of is this grandson who was raised by himself.
His son and daughter-in-law are waiting for him underground. When he gets there, he will tell them that this child was raised very well by the old man...
There was the sound of gentle footsteps outside, and Xu Gan's ears twitched to identify the person.
It's not Han Xiaoliu. Xu Le didn't take him with him on the trip. Han Xiaoliu has been depressed these days. You can even hang an oil bottle on your mouth. He must have been keeping watch outside at night. Children doze off a lot, so he is probably in a deep sleep now.
It will only be the Han family.
This is a family that I rescued in Hedong when I went north. He has always followed himself loyally, opened up wasteland, and settled down. After her husband passed away, only one woman took care of the Xu family's domestic and domestic chores. Even her son Han Yue is now by Xu Le's side, venturing north together.
The heavy door curtain was opened, and it was indeed Han who came in. She was carrying a tray with steaming wheat porridge, a plate of pickled vegetables, and a plate of smoked fish. He looked at Xu Gan with worry.
"Grandpa, I haven't eaten anything all day today, and I haven't slept at all. What's going to happen if this keeps up? Wouldn't it be better to eat a little?"
Xu Gan forced a smile and said: "At the end of the day, I have already drank enough medicine, so I can't take it anymore. I will go to sleep in a while, so you don't have to worry, Mr. Han."
Mrs. Han put down the tray and looked at Xu Gan: "My grandpa just cares about you..."
Xu Gan closed his eyes.
Han's eyes were a little red and she wiped them with her sleeves: "I also watched Le Langjun grow up and end up with a lot of talents. The world is so chaotic now. At that time, the grandpa didn't allow Le Langjun to take a step in martial arts. Why do you let Le Langjun go through this hardship just to get some free money? It's really not possible. The house and land have been sold. Are you afraid that you won't be able to pass this test?"
Xu Gan closed his eyes and spoke softly: "The old man can't protect him for too long..."
Han stopped talking and listened to the old man's words. There was an indescribable desolation in his voice: "The world is going to be in chaos...and I am getting old. I once thought that I would just let A Le live an ordinary life." Forget it. But that is a matter of peace. Now, another era of bloodshed and competition among heroes is about to begin... In this era, A Le's abilities cannot be hidden, they cannot be hidden..."
The old man murmured, and there was an indescribable sense of mystery: "In this chaotic world, God will summon countless heroes to come out and sacrifice their flesh and blood until the last person stands on the highest place. There is nothing to hide, there is nothing to hide... If it were ten years ago, I would have fought with this old bone, but now, after I go, I can only rely on Ale himself. I can only let him go on the road and see the bloody chaos of this world as soon as possible..."
Han didn't understand some of the words. But he understood the general meaning and asked with a trembling voice: "Will Mr. Lelang be okay..."
Xu Gan, who had been tired, suddenly opened his eyes. His old eyes were full of power, as sharp as lightning!
"How can something happen to the grandson whom I, Xu Gan, taught with my own hands? Ale is more beautiful than his father, and his sharpness is even more natural. As long as he always walks on the straight path, he can poke a hole in the sky if the sky wants to suppress it!"
Han repeated the two words she didn't understand: "Zhi Dao?"
Xu Gan said sternly: "Don't give in."He has disgraced his body and ambition and is a running dog of a noble family. Even if Yingye kills people, it is just to restore peace to the world! "
At this moment, another young man seemed to appear in front of Xu Gan's eyes. Slightly older than Xu Le, less than thirty years old. His eyebrows resemble Xu Le's, but his expression is more stable than Xu Le's. Standing tall and straight, he spoke loudly to himself.
"...The child is not coveting future wealth and honor, but the Duke of Yue and the King of Jin slandered Gao Xi, brought trouble to the court, and tried to seize the throne of the crown prince. At the end of the Sui Dynasty, the north and the south were separated, and the Five Husties disrupted China's era. We cannot let this peaceful world be ruined in the hands of the Duke of Yue and the King of Jin! The son, under the orders of the Duke, is determined to guard the prince, just to protect the straight path in his heart! "
The figure disappeared and left, Xu Gan closed his eyes tightly, and a drop of old tears fell: "... But my son, you are still abandoned by the family... The old man has been thinking about you all the time for more than ten years, all the time, all the time..."
Han did not dare to disturb Xu Gan anymore, turned around slightly, lifted the door curtain and couldn't help but look back.
